rows.41:c1fc:
That's right.
That's what she said.
That she wanted to be made even more beautiful. More and more beautiful.
Then this time, the fortune-teller asked for her nails.{p}
rows.41:c510:
And the next day.
The very first thing she did was look in the mirror.
She'd cried all night, so she figured her face had to look awful.
But then...
In the mirror was herself, prettier than yesterday.
Her eyelids weren't puffy in the slightest.
Big round eyes, with curling lashes.
Her skin looked fairer than the day before, too.
She was more impressed with that fortune-teller than ever.
She had no room left to think anything was strange.
And she thought this.
I want to be even more beautiful. More and more beautiful.{p}
rows.41:c6f0:
And so, that night, when she went to the fortune-teller...
There in the room, she saw the back of someone who looked like Tanaka's current girlfriend.
Hirai panicked.
She thought maybe that girl had gotten this fortune-teller to make her beautiful too.
And that maybe that was how she'd won Tanaka's heart.
Just as Hirai was about to confront her...
"Ugh!☆"
Hirai clutched her chest and collapsed.{p}
rows.41:db58:
Maybe she couldn't give up on Tanaka after all, or maybe the fortune-teller's smile looked like a challenge, but Hirai answered firmly.
"I'm not scared.
Let's continue."
That's what she said.
"My apologies.
Of course you're not.
It's only a matter of letting two or three drops of blood fall from your little finger, after all."
The fortune-teller was still smirking.
But when Hirai heard just two or three drops, she was secretly relieved.
That much, she could think of as just a little cut...
And so, gripping the knife in a hand that still trembled, she cut the very tip of her left little finger, just a tiny bit.{p}
rows.41:e184:
"Well, you sure can't give a straight answer, can you?
I can't ask someone like you for anything.
I'll be on my way."
Fed up with Hirai, who had gone silent, the old woman marched right out of the tent.
As she left, the old woman glanced back at Hirai for just an instant.
With the light behind her, Hirai couldn't see her well, but those eyes and that smirking grin reminded her of someone.
"Wait!"{p}
rows.41:fc38:
And then the fortune-teller raised the knife high...
"I will be using all the blood in your body."{p}
